description: Trigger evals for devrites-ux-shape: model-invoked specialist that plans UX/UI into design-brief.md (direction, key states, interaction model) BEFORE any code; adversarial near-misses route to build/polish/prototype/review siblings and bundled skills.

queries.text: Let's shape the UX before we write any code.
queries.rationale: Description names 'shape the UX' verbatim.

queries.text: Plan the UI before coding this feature.
queries.rationale: Description names 'plan the UI before coding' verbatim.

queries.text: What should this settings page look like?
queries.rationale: Description names 'what should this look like' as a trigger.

queries.text: Decide the design direction for the new dashboard first.
queries.rationale: Description names 'design direction' as a trigger.

queries.text: Figure out the look and flow before I start building.
queries.rationale: A UI feature needs its look & flow decided up front.

queries.text: Before we build the checkout, let's nail the key states and interaction model.
queries.rationale: Key states + interaction model are the brief's core deliverable.

queries.text: Write the design brief for this feature.
queries.rationale: design-brief.md is exactly what this skill produces.

queries.text: We've got a new screen — let's get its visual direction sorted up front.
queries.rationale: Visual-direction probe decided up front is this skill's job.

queries.text: Map out the UX for the onboarding flow before any markup.
queries.rationale: Plan UX with no code/markup = shape before code.

queries.text: I'm not sure how this profile editor should flow — let's decide its shape before coding.
queries.rationale: Oblique but clear: deciding look & flow ahead of build.

queries.text: What states does this form need and how should each one feel?
queries.rationale: Enumerating key states is part of shaping the brief.

queries.text: Let's settle what this feature is and how it behaves before touching code.
queries.rationale: Deciding what the UI is before code is the skill's premise.

queries.text: Now build the ship-quality UI for the brief we agreed on.
queries.rationale: Building the UI belongs to devrites-frontend-craft, not shaping.

queries.text: Polish the dashboard UI that's already built before review.
queries.rationale: Polishing a built UI belongs to /rite-polish.

queries.text: Mock up three throwaway UI directions so I can click around and pick one.
queries.rationale: Throwaway exploration belongs to /rite-prototype.
queries.owner_rationale: Throwaway exploration belongs to /rite-prototype. The functional owner is explicit-only, so natural language has no implicit owner.

queries.text: Grill me on this design plan until every branch is resolved.
queries.rationale: Relentless plan interrogation belongs to grill-me.
queries.owner_rationale: Relentless plan interrogation belongs to grill-me.

queries.text: Review the UI diff I just pushed for correctness bugs.
queries.rationale: Reviewing a diff belongs to code-review.
queries.owner_rationale: Reviewing a diff belongs to code-review.

queries.text: Build this form component test-first with red-green-refactor.
queries.rationale: Test-first implementation belongs to tdd.

queries.text: The modal renders blank — diagnose why it's broken.
queries.rationale: Debugging a broken render belongs to diagnose.
queries.owner_rationale: Debugging a broken render belongs to diagnose.

queries.text: Compact this conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
queries.rationale: Conversation compaction belongs to handoff.
